summary: 完整作者BrainHGT＋论文定义OMST在四个公开疼痛队列完成。ZAN54 AUROC 0.4345/0.4138；SRPBS99 AUROC 0.5972/0.6653；Emo53 AUROC 0.5214/0.4872；偏头痛132 AUROC 0.4560/0.4217。
boundary: 既有公开疼痛队列患者/对照诊断开发；原人级划分/QC保持，无新增同期疼痛/疗效真值或独立验证。按论文定义构建OMST，核心作者模型原容量、无新增协变量分支；未说明的实现选择显式记录。
next: 完成老师要求的完整BrainHGT疼痛对照；不按OOF追加搜索。新指标与小样本学习需另有机制假设和有限标签预算，现阶段不称few-shot或临床验证。
method: Intact author BrainHGT:256/8/1,FF1024,encoder32,communities8,dropout0.1; no extra covariate head；Pearson signed node features; Kruskal orthogonal spanning trees; sequential individual-edge GE-Cost argmax; nonnegative selected absolute-weight adjacency

implementation_choices.global_efficiency: Mean inverse weighted shortest path, no dense GE normalization
implementation_choices.cost: Selected absolute correlation sum / dense upper-triangle absolute correlation sum
implementation_choices.stopping: Residual graph cannot form another complete spanning tree; residual forest not appended
implementation_choices.output: Selected |r| with zero diagonal; node R retains original signs

training_protocol.selection: Inner highest AUROC, earliest exact tie; median inner epoch, two-inner median floor; no outer query selection

uncertainty: 2000人级配对条件抽样，不含重训、累计选择、多比较或独立临床重复；相关外折和两个种子不当独立人群。
historical_comparison: Old positive-FC models differ in covariate head, epochs, selection and loss; no single-factor OMST-gain claim
interpretation: ZAN54未形成两个种子均获正向条件区间的结果；SRPBS99未形成两个种子均获正向条件区间的结果；Emo53未形成两个种子均获正向条件区间的结果；偏头痛132未形成两个种子均获正向条件区间的结果。
